SP ENW - GIS - Conductor - Staffordshire Moorlands

description: SP ENW GIS conductor layers is a series of datasets listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Shared SP ENW - GIS - Conductors - Carlisle This dataset depicts the sections of underground and overhead conductors, which are owned by SP ENW and are located within the referenced Local Authority area. This dataset does not knowingly contain any privately owned assets. Coverage: 40 local areas (Allerdale, Barrow-in-Furness, Blackburn with Darwen, Blackpool, Bolton and others). The portal lists 40 near-identical datasets in this series, one per area, all with the same structure; they are grouped in this one record and each has its own page on the portal (the first few are linked). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is SP ENW Shared Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
